subject: Origin Medical // Encord - Request for temporary increase in Encord users
text:
Hi Arisha,

I hope you are doing well. 

I wanted to quickly check an option with you.

Currently, our Encord account is at full capacity with 30 active users. We have an immediate requirement to run a pilot project with approximately 5–8 users for one week to assess feasibility. If the pilot proceeds successfully, we will move forward with the project, and by that time, the current users will be offloaded from the platform by the end of next week.

Given this, would it be possible to temporarily add 5–8 additional users to the platform for just one week to support this pilot? This short-term increase would not affect capacity beyond next week, and we would not want to disrupt any of the currently active users.

We will also keep you informed of the exact start and end dates for this pilot.

Please let me know if this can be accommodated.

Warm Regards,
Jagruthi D Atada

Director of Clinical Data Engineering

subject: Re: Encord/Tau Robotics - Services for G1_Mobile Project
text:
Hi Richa,

I've reviewed a couple videos now. The labels are mostly good.
But a few were very off. This happens often if the humanoid drops
something. For example, it drops the first bottle and grabs the second one,
instruction is to grab it. This should not be a 3 or 4. This is bad or very
bad. I don't think any customer likes a humanoid that just drops their
stuff on the floor. It didn't even pick it up from the floor.
Also, sometimes the robot completes the task but does something else
afterwards. This should not happen. It should only execute the task. If the
behavior afterwards can be easily reversed, it's not too bad.

Imagine you want the humanoid to do a complex task and you are guiding it
by giving it a sequence of simpler language instructions. If you tell it to
grab something and it drops it, that makes your life very hard. If it's
very slow, that's also annoying. If it bumps into the desk and something
falls over, that's not good. If it breaks or it's someone else's home where
you want to be very careful, it could be very bad.

Best,
Alex
